title: Work Unit Catalog (command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json)
description: Container contract for the program catalog. Two independent arrays coexist ON PURPOSE and must never be merged: `work_units` (the 19-field Prompt-Two decomposition) and `items` (the 33-field pre-existing backlog register). `defaults` is OPTIONAL: every unit in `work_units` carries all 19 fields itself, so removing `defaults` entirely cannot invalidate a single unit. That property is asserted mechanically by platform/lib/wfdsl/test_work_unit_schema.py::test_defaults_block_is_optional_not_load_bearing.

defaults.$comment: OPTIONAL authoring convenience only. A field present here does NOT satisfy that field's per-unit requirement; the resolver in platform/lib/wfdsl/resolve.py fills a MISSING field from here only in explicit 'resolved' mode, and the raw catalog contract still requires all 19 per unit.

tool_policy.$comment: The authorization plane for `work_units`, read by platform/lib/wfdsl/semantics.py::check_work_unit_authorization (SEM-008..SEM-011). It deliberately $refs the DSL plane's EXISTING `$defs/tool_policy` rather than declaring a second vocabulary: the two planes share one allow/deny/require_owner_approval partition with `default: deny`, so a policy authored for a workflow reads identically here (platform/architecture/TOURNAMENT-VERDICT.md 1.1 and 3.1 - a duplicate control plane was ruled inadmissible). OPTIONAL in the schema, but its ABSENCE is not permissive: SEM-008 fails closed and reports every requested tool as denied, so a catalog with no policy is a red gate, not a skipped one. Note that `$defs/tool_policy` sets additionalProperties:false, so the instance carries no `$comment` of its own - the rationale for each entry lives in command-center/authz_apply_fixes.py and command-center/D2-WORKUNIT-AUTHZ.md.

items.$comment: the 33-field backlog register - a DIFFERENT schema; validated by its own contract, not by this one

defaults_block.description: Every property mirrors a work-unit field and is optional. No property is required, because a catalog with NO defaults block at all must still validate.
